# Continual-ARC puzzle solving

Use this procedure when handling a puzzle in a Continual-ARC stream.

1. Read the task id, test grid, attempt/demo counts, and the supplied `programs/` location. Check for `programs/<task id>.py` before requesting demos or doing other puzzle work. Do not submit a hand-composed grid.
3. Run the transform on every received input/output pair and compare complete grids exactly. Preserve demos as received; never use a sparse reconstruction or hand-derived expected output, since transcription errors can masquerade as rule failures. After each code edit, rerun every pair; an exception or mismatch means the program is not validated, so do not submit yet. If transcribing a grid for execution, check its row and column counts against the stated header before using its output. Before submission, check that the returned grid has 1–30 nonempty rows of equal length, with only integer cell values 0–9; output dimensions need not equal the input dimensions.
